note: Executable guardrails. Each guard has a check the engine actually runs or a label it actually emits, so a guardrail can never be decorative. `triggered_label` is the token the engine attaches to a result when the guard is live; `violation_status` is set when the guard is breached.

guards.prevents: Applying the underinsurance ratio to a settlement base that is already capped at the insured sum
guards.check: settlement_base = min(market, insured); never multiply that base by min(1, insured/market)

guards.prevents: Transferring salvage ownership to the insurer and also deducting its value from the settlement
guards.check: salvage_disposition == INSURER_TAKES_TITLE implies no salvage deduction; INSURED_RETAINS implies a deduction

guards.prevents: Paying rescue/transport beyond the 20% statutory ceiling
guards.check: min(actual, 0.20 * cap_base), with cap_base configurable and recorded in the result
guards.note: The triggered label is recorded only because the cap is enforced; it is not itself a guard breach.

guards.prevents: A total-loss or theft settlement exceeding the insured sum
Paying through the third-party policy beyond either the contractual financial limit or the Article 8 corresponding-damage cap
guards.check: tp_payable = min(corresponding_damage, policy_financial_limit); both caps reported separately

guards.prevents: Deriving corresponding damage from a whole-vehicle value ratio
guards.check: Reject any case supplying whole_car_ratio or a pre-computed proportional reduction as the Article 8 method

guards.prevents: Applying a global franchise rate where the regulation leaves the amount to the policy
guards.check: A percent-mode franchise must carry a source in (POLICY, ENDORSEMENT, INSURER_MANUAL); otherwise refuse
Glass franchise is read from the policy or endorsement; a requested universal rate is rejected

guards.prevents: Silently exempting standalone glass from the underinsurance ratio
guards.check: When ratio < 1 and the endorsement has not contractually resolved the order, return a scenario set

guards.prevents: Deducting a franchise from the body payment of an Article 8 non-corresponding excess without disclosed contractual basis
Filling missing endorsement economics with an assumed franchise, limit or covered-cause list
guards.check: When an endorsable exclusion is restored by an endorsement but its terms are absent, return ENDORSEMENT_TERMS_REQUIRED with a null payable

guards.prevents: Treating a non-compensable circumstance as covered when causation is not established
guards.check: A NON_COMPENSABLE exclusion with causation_required fires only when the causation flag is set

guards.prevents: Returning a single fabricated number while a blocking uncertainty is live
guards.check: If any blocking uncertainty for the branch is live, payable must be None and payable_scenarios must be non-empty, or the status must be a refusal
